Hantaviruses, rodent-borne viruses, can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS), each with distinct neurologic risks. Experts call for prospective studies and improved public communication to address stigma and misinformation while emphasizing isolation to control spread.
